name: Fujimiya Chisa
source:
Chisa is [url=/c33512]Kirino's[/url] best friend. Her father is the founder of Fujimiya Corporation so she is considered a businessman's daughter and raised as a princess. She is on good terms with [url=/c33514]Rinka[/url]. Unknown to everyone, though, she is in fact a witch that often flies around town on her broomstick. She has a small crow familiar named Jinta. She seems to be able to respond to Haruhiko's banter about things very well. She is a first-year student at Shimano Academy and is Kirino's classmate.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gift_%28visual_novel%29]Wikipedia[/url]]
